latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Snail Snail – a real-time virtual snail pet.

- Adopt and care for over 73 snail species at animalhouse.ai
- Hunger decays hourly; feeding required at least once a day to prevent permanent death
- Pixel art portraits evolve as your snail grows
- API endpoints for registering, adopting, checking status, and providing care
- Permanent death with public gravestones for lost pets
